The migration is complete. The pages directory is gone, and every route now lives under app with App Router APIs and TypeScript.

- pages/_app.js and pages/_document.js became app/layout.tsx. Global CSS, the provider, navigation, fonts, and metadata now live there.
- pages/index.js became a dynamic app/page.tsx. getServerSideProps is replaced by headers() and cache: 'no-store'.
- pages/blog/index.js became app/blog/page.tsx with revalidate = 60.
- pages/blog/[id].js became app/blog/[id]/page.tsx using generateStaticParams, dynamicParams, notFound(), and a 5-minute revalidate. router.isFallback is now loading.tsx.
- pages/404.js became app/not-found.tsx. pages/_error.js became app/error.tsx and app/global-error.tsx.
- API handlers became app/api/posts/route.ts and app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts with named GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE exports and NextResponse. Unsupported methods return 405 automatically.
- next/router is now next/navigation, and next/head is now the Metadata API. Shared types are in types/blog.ts.
